transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the removal of solvent storage tank T-14 from the expansion bay beside the finishing department. As you know, T-14 has been isolated from production for several months, and that bay is slated for the new dust-collection system installation later this month. I'll be making the final facilities decision on whether and how T-14 is removed, but per our normal pre-work review process, I need each of you — maintenance, environmental, production planning, and permit compliance — to formally enter your reviewed findings into the meeting record before I settle on a work plan. Let's start hearing from each area.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I completed my field assessment of T-14 yesterday. Here are my maintenance findings: the tank can be dismantled in exactly 6 labor hours and requires exactly 8 lockout points. I have not yet entered the work package into the maintenance system, but I'm entering these reviewed findings into the meeting record now.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Here are my environmental findings for the record: My residue sample review has classified the remaining tank residue in T-14 as hazardous solvent waste. It requires exactly 3 labeled drums and a signed waste-transfer manifest for proper removal. The laboratory result arrived this morning, and I should note that the environmental register has not yet been updated with this classification. I am entering these reviewed findings into the meeting record now.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Here are my production planning findings for the record: My floor-space review found that dismantled tank sections must be staged in marked area B12 because every other nearby staging area is reserved for the dust-collector installation. I confirmed the reservation with production scheduling this afternoon. I have not yet circulated the updated bay map, but I am entering these reviewed findings into the meeting record now.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Here are my permit compliance findings for the record: My permit review found that removing T-14 requires an internal hot-work and confined-space permit package, including a documented atmospheric test before cutting begins. I confirmed this against the current site permit matrix this week. I have not yet attached the permit package to the facilities request, but I am entering these reviewed findings into the meeting record now.
